# Setup/Preprocessing

```{r}
# Packages
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(readr)
library(nlme)
library(nlraa)
library(MuMIn)
library(patchwork)
library(ggpubr)
theme_set(theme_classic())

# Relative working directory
active_wd <- function(x, output = FALSE) {
    rdir <- dirname(rstudioapi::getActiveDocumentContext()$path)
    rdir <- sub("[^/]*$", "", rdir)
    rdir <- paste0(rdir, x)
    setwd(rdir)
    if (output == TRUE) {
        return(getwd())
    }
}
active_wd("data")

# Read in data
data <- read_csv("full_data.csv")
data12 <- data[data$exp %in% c("1", "2"),]
data3 <- data[data$exp %in% c("3a", "3b"),]

# Data processing - turn into PSEs

psefunc <- function(df, reversals = 4) {
# Select final 4 reversals in each staircase for each Participant
last_revs <- data.frame()
for (i in unique(df$Participant)) {
  for (j in unique(df$start_id)) {
    for (k in unique(df$type)) {
      for (l in unique(df$envelope_1)) {
        for (m in unique(df$repetition)) {
          for (n in unique(df$direction)) {
            rev = subset(df, Participant == i & type == k & envelope_1 == l & repetition == m & direction == n & l_reversal == 1)
            if (!j %in% rev$start_id) next
            rev = subset(rev, start_id == j)
            num = length(rev$l_reversal) - reversals
            rev = rev[-c(1:num),]
            last_revs <- rbind(last_revs, rev)
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

# Categorise each reversal
k = 1
for (i in 1:nrow(last_revs)) {
  if (k > reversals) k = 1
  last_revs$trial_num[i] <- k
  k = k + 1
}

# Group and condense response/reversal data
revs <- last_revs |> 
  group_by(Participant, start_id, direction, envelope_1, type, repetition, trial_num, exp) |> 
  summarise("Level" = mean(second - first)) |> 
  mutate("trial_num" = as.integer(trial_num), "start_id" = factor(start_id)) |> 
  arrange(Participant, start_id, direction, envelope_1, type, repetition, trial_num)

# Calculate PSE for each standard and envelope for each participant
pse <- revs |> 
  group_by(Participant, start_id, envelope_1, type, repetition, exp) |> 
  summarise("PSE" = mean(Level))

# Get standard value and overall comparator value
pse$PSEtotal <- 0
pse$standard <- 0
for (i in 1:length(unique(pse$envelope_1))) {
  for (j in 1:length(unique(pse$start_id))) {
    e <- unique(pse$envelope_1)[i]
    if (!j %in% unique(pse$start_id[pse$envelope_1 == e])) next
    pse$PSEtotal[pse$envelope_1 == unique(pse$envelope_1)[i] & pse$start_id == j] <- df$first[df$envelope_1 == unique(pse$envelope_1)[i] & df$start_id == j] + pse$PSE[pse$envelope_1 == unique(pse$envelope_1)[i] & pse$start_id == j]
    pse$standard[pse$envelope_1 == unique(pse$envelope_1)[i] & pse$start_id == j] <- df$first[df$envelope_1 == unique(pse$envelope_1)[i] & df$start_id == j]
  }
}

# Initialise x and y columns for models
pse$x <- 0
pse$y <- 0

# For homogenous condition, x is always the standard and y is always the comparator
pse$x[pse$type == "Homogenous"] <- pse$standard[pse$type == "Homogenous"]
pse$y[pse$type == "Homogenous"] <- pse$PSEtotal[pse$type == "Homogenous"]

# For heterogenous condition, x is always the flat tone and y is always the percussive tone
pse$x[pse$type == "Heterogenous"] <- with(
    pse[pse$type == "Heterogenous",],
    ifelse(
        envelope_1 == "flat",
        standard,
        PSEtotal
    )
)
pse$y[pse$type == "Heterogenous"] <- with(
    pse[pse$type == "Heterogenous",],
    ifelse(
        envelope_1 == "flat",
        PSEtotal,
        standard
    )
)

# Cleaning and final processes
pse$repetition <- as.factor(pse$repetition)
pse$envelope_1 <- as.factor(pse$envelope_1)
pse$Participant <- factor(pse$Participant, label = "p")

return(pse)
}

pse12 <- psefunc(data12)
pse3 <- psefunc(data3)
# Split by experiment
exp1 <- data.frame(pse12[pse12$exp == "1",])
exp1 <- groupedData(formula = y ~ x | Participant, data = exp1)
exp2 <- data.frame(pse12[pse12$exp == "2",])
exp2 <- groupedData(formula = y ~ x | Participant, data = exp2)
exp3_hom <- data.frame(pse3[pse3$exp == "3a",])
exp3_hom <- groupedData(formula = y ~ x | Participant, data = exp3_hom)
exp3_het <- data.frame(pse3[pse3$exp == "3b",])
exp3_het <- groupedData(formula = y ~ x | Participant, data = exp3_het)
avtest <- rbind(exp3_het, exp2)
avtest$dataset <- c(rep("A", 100), rep("B", 220))
avtest <- groupedData(formula = y ~ x | dataset/Participant, data = avtest)


# Setup for figures 4 and 6
hetpse <- exp3_het
hompse <- exp3_hom
envelopes2 <- rbind(hetpse, hetpse)
envelopes2$Participant <- as.character(envelopes2$Participant)
envelopes2$Participant[101:200] <- "Overall"
pse2 <- rbind(hompse, hompse)
pse2$Participant <- as.character(pse2$Participant)
pse2$Participant[101:200] <- "Overall"
poly <- data.frame(x = c(900, 1700, 1700, 900), y = c(600, 600, 200, 200))
pseall <- rbind(pse3, pse3)
pseall$Participant <- as.character(pseall$Participant)
pseall$Participant[201:400] <- "Overall"
pseall <- pseall |>
    group_by(Participant, standard, envelope_1, type) |>
    summarise(m = max(PSEtotal))
pseall <- pseall |> slice(rep(1:n(), each = 2))
pseall$m[seq(0, (nrow(pseall) - 2), 2) + 1] <- 200
pseall$m[pseall$type == "Homogenous" & pseall$envelope_1 == "perc" & pseall$m == 200] <- 1700
pseall$m[pseall$type == "Homogenous" & pseall$envelope_1 == "perc" & pseall$m != 1700] <- pse2 |>
    filter(type == "Homogenous" & envelope_1 == "perc") |>
    group_by(Participant, standard) |>
    summarise(m = min(PSEtotal)) |>
    pull(m)
pse2$group <- rep(pse2$Participant[1:(nrow(pse2) / 2)], 2)
envelopes2$group <- rep(envelopes2$Participant[1:(nrow(envelopes2) / 2)], 2)
pseall$m[pseall$type == "Homogenous" & pseall$Participant == "Overall" & pseall$m == 1700] <- 200
pseall$m[pseall$type == "Homogenous" & pseall$Participant == "Overall" & pseall$m != 200] <- 1700
pseall$m[pseall$type == "Heterogenous" & pseall$Participant == "Overall" & pseall$m != 200] <- 1700
```

# Model building

## Experiment 1
```{r}
# Experiment 1 - Random effects & varPower
exp11 <- lme(
    fixed = y ~ x * envelope_1,
    random = ~ 1 + x | Participant,
    data = exp1,
    control = lmeControl(maxIter = 200, opt = "optim", returnObject = TRUE)
)

exp12 <- lme(
    fixed = y ~ x * envelope_1,
    random = ~ 0 + x | Participant,
    data = exp1
)

exp13 <- lme(
    fixed = y ~ x * envelope_1,
    random = ~ 1 | Participant,
    data = exp1
)

exp14 <- gls(
    y ~ x * envelope_1,
    data = exp1
)

exp15 <- lme(
    fixed = y ~ x * envelope_1,
    random = ~ 1 + x | Participant,
    data = exp1,
    weights = varPower(form = ~ fitted(.))
)

exp16 <- lme(
    fixed = y ~ x * envelope_1,
    random = ~ 0 + x | Participant,
    data = exp1,
    weights = varPower(form = ~ fitted(.))
)

exp17 <- lme(
    fixed = y ~ x * envelope_1,
    random = ~ 1 | Participant,
    data = exp1,
    weights = varPower(form = ~ fitted(.))
)

exp18 <- gls( # This is the best model
    y ~ x * envelope_1,
    data = exp1,
    weights = varPower(form = ~ fitted(.))
)

anova(exp11,exp12,exp13,exp14,exp15,exp16,exp17,exp18)

# Experiment 1 - selecting fixed effects

exp1a <- exp18

exp1b <- gls( 
    y ~ x + envelope_1,
    data = exp1,
    weights = varPower(form = ~ fitted(.))
)

exp1c <- gls( 
    y ~ x + x:envelope_1,
    data = exp1,
    weights = varPower(form = ~ fitted(.))
)

exp1d <- gls( # This is the best model
    y ~ x,
    data = exp1,
    weights = varPower(form = ~ fitted(.))
)

anova(
    update(exp1a, method = "ML"),
    update(exp1b, method = "ML"),
    update(exp1c, method = "ML"),
    update(exp1d, method = "ML")
)

# Experiment 1 - Intercept and/or slope

exp1i <- gls(
    y ~ 1 + x,
    data = exp1,
    weights = varPower(form = ~ fitted(.))
)

exp1ii <- gls( # This is the best model
    y ~ 0 + x,
    data = exp1,
    weights = varPower(form = ~ fitted(.))
)

anova(
    update(exp1i, method = "ML"),
    update(exp1ii, method = "ML")
)
```

# Final models

```{r}
# Experiment 1
exp1_model <- gls( # This is the best model
    y ~ 0 + x,
    data = exp1,
    weights = varPower(form = ~ fitted(.))
)
summary(exp1_model)
exp1$residuals <- residuals(exp1_model, type = "p")
qqnorm(exp1$residuals)
qqline(exp1$residuals)
exp1_boot <- boot_gls(exp1_model, cores = 8, R = 1000)
```

```{r}
# Experiment 2
exp2_model <- lme(
    fixed = y ~ 1 + x,
    random = ~ 0 + x | Participant,
    data = exp2
)
summary(exp2_model)
exp2$residuals <- residuals(exp2_model, type = "p")
qqnorm(exp2$residuals)
qqline(exp2$residuals)
exp2_boot <- boot_lme(exp2_model, cores = 8, R = 1000)
```

```{r}
# Experiment 3a

)
summary(exp3_hom_model)
exp3_hom$residuals <- residuals(exp3_hom_model, type = "p")
qqnorm(exp3_hom$residuals)
qqline(exp3_hom$residuals)
exp3_hom_boot <- boot_gls(exp3_hom_model, cores = 8, R = 1000)
```


```{r}

avtest_model <- lme(
    fixed = y ~ 1 + x,
    random = ~ 0 + x | dataset/Participant,
    data = avtest,
    weights = varPower(form = ~ fitted(.) | dataset),
    control = lmeControl(maxIter = 200, opt = "optim", returnObject = TRUE)
)

avtest$residuals <- residuals(avtest_model, type = "p")
```

```{r}
# Function to make bootstrap plot
bootstrap_plot <- function(bootdf, model, hist_ylim = c(0, 220), bins = 45, intlim = c(-50, 250), slopelim = c(0.8, 1.6), reglim = c(200, 1700), testlim = list(c(200,1700), c(200,1700)), homlab = "Homogenous", hetlab = "Heterogenous") {
    require(ggplot2)
    require(performance)
    require(patchwork)
    colors <- c("#66b6b8", "#994947")
    histlist <- c()
    lims <- list(intlim, slopelim)
    labs <- c("Intercept", "Slope")
    regxlab <- c("Standard (ms)", "Flat (ms)")
    regylab <- c("Comparator (ms)", "Percussive (ms)")
    ci <- function(x) {
        l <- quantile(x, 0.025, na.rm = T)
        u <- quantile(x, 0.975, na.rm = T)
        return(c(l, u))
    }
    ci_df <- data.frame(
        loop = rep(1:2, each = 2),
        type = rep(c("Homogenous", "Heterogenous"), times = 2),
        y = rep(c(hist_ylim[2] * 0.95, hist_ylim[2] * 0.85), times = 2),
        l = 0,
        u = 0,
        f = 0
    )
    for (i in 1:nrow(ci_df)) {
        ci_df$l[i] <- ci(bootdf[with(bootdf, type) == ci_df$type[i], ci_df$loop[i]])[1]
        ci_df$u[i] <- ci(bootdf[with(bootdf, type) == ci_df$type[i], ci_df$loop[i]])[2]
    }
    ci_df$f <- c(
        model[[1]]$coefficients[1],
        coefficients(summary(model[[2]]))[1, 1],
        model[[1]]$coefficients[2],
        coefficients(summary(model[[2]]))[2, 1]
    )
    for (i in 1:2) {
        histlist[[i]] <- data.frame("." = bootdf[, i], "type" = factor(bootdf[, 3], levels = c("Homogenous", "Heterogenous"))) |>
            ggplot(aes(.)) +
            geom_histogram(
                aes(fill = type),
                color = "black",
                linewidth = 0.1,
                position = position_identity(),
                alpha = 0.95,
                bins = bins
            ) +
            geom_errorbar(
                data = ci_df[ci_df$loop == i, ],
                aes(
                    y = y,
                    xmin = l,
                    xmax = u,
                    color = factor(type, levels = c("Homogenous", "Heterogenous"))
                ),
                inherit.aes = F
            ) +
            geom_point(
                data = ci_df[ci_df$loop == i, ],
                aes(f, y, color = factor(type, levels = c("Homogenous", "Heterogenous"))),
                pch = 21,
                fill = "white",
                inherit.aes = F
            ) +
            scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
            coord_cartesian(xlim = lims[[i]], ylim = hist_ylim) +
            labs(x = labs[i], title = LETTERS[i]) +
            theme(
                axis.text.y = element_blank(),
                axis.title.y = element_blank(),
                axis.ticks.y = element_blank()
            ) +
            scale_color_manual("Comparison", values = colors, labels = c("Homogenous" = homlab, "Heterogenous" = hetlab)) +
            scale_fill_manual("Comparison", values = colors, labels = c("Homogenous" = homlab, "Heterogenous" = hetlab))
    }
    types <- c("Homogenous", "Heterogenous")
    r2list <- c()
    for (i in 1:2) {
        r2list[i] <- ifelse(
            class(model[[i]]) == "lme",
            r.squaredGLMM(model[[i]])[[2]],
            cor(model[[i]]$fitted, (model[[i]]$fitted + model[[i]]$residuals))^2
        )
    }
    reglist <- c()
    for (i in 1:2) {
        ci_df_i <- dplyr::filter(ci_df, type == types[i])
        bootdf_i <- filter(bootdf, type == types[i])
        reglist[[i]] <- ggplot(data.frame(), aes(0, 0)) +
            coord_cartesian(xlim = reglim, ylim = reglim) +
            geom_abline(intercept = bootdf_i[, 1], slope = bootdf_i[, 2], alpha = 0.01, color = "grey50") +
            geom_abline(intercept = ci_df_i$f[1], slope = ci_df_i$f[2], linewidth = 0.7, color = colors[i]) +
            labs(x = regxlab[i], y = regylab[i], title = paste0(LETTERS[i + 2])) +
            geom_polygon(
                data = data.frame(
                    x = c(0,0,testlim[[i]][1],testlim[[i]][1]),
                    y = c(0,2000,2000,0)
                ),
                aes(
                    x = x,
                    y = y
                ),
                linetype = 0,
                fill = "white",
                alpha = 0.8
            ) +
            geom_polygon(
                data = data.frame(
                    x = c(testlim[[i]][2],testlim[[i]][2],2000,2000),
                    y = c(0,2000,2000,0)
                ),
                aes(
                    x = x,
                    y = y
                ),
                linetype = 0,
                fill = "white",
                alpha = 0.8
            ) +
            annotate(
                "text",
                x = 1000,
                y = 500,
                label = paste0(
                    "y = ",
                    round(ci_df_i$f[1]),
                    " + ",
                    round(ci_df_i$f[2], 2),
                    "x"
                ),
                hjust = "left",
                size = 4
            ) +
            annotate(
                "text",
                x = 1000,
                y = 375,
                label = paste0(
                    "R^2 == ",
                    round(r2list[i], 2)
                ),
                parse = TRUE,
                hjust = "left",
                size = 4
            )
    }
    return(((histlist[[1]] + histlist[[2]]) / (reglist[[1]] + reglist[[2]])) + plot_layout(guides = "collect"))
}
```
